title: A Time for Everything

questions.question: For everything there is a season, and a time for every matter under where?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 3:1 (ESV): "For everything there is a season, and a time for every matter under heaven:"

questions.question: A time to be born, and a time to what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 3:2 (ESV): "a time to be born, and a time to die;"

questions.question: He has made everything beautiful in its what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 3:11 (ESV): "He has made everything beautiful in its time."

questions.question: What has God put into man's heart?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 3:11 (ESV): "Also, he has put eternity into man's heart,"

questions.question: Are all (men and beasts) from the dust, and to dust all return?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 3:20 (ESV): "All go to one place. All are from the dust, and to dust all return."

questions.question: A time to weep, and a time to what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 3:4 (ESV): "a time to weep, and a time to laugh;"

questions.question: A time to cast away stones, and a time to what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 3:5 (ESV): "a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together;"

questions.question: I perceived that there is nothing better for them than to be joyful and to do what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 3:12 (ESV): "I perceived that there is nothing better for them than to be joyful and to do good as long as they live;"

questions.question: Whatever God does endures for how long?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 3:14 (ESV): "I perceived that whatever God does endures forever;"

questions.question: In the place of justice, even there was what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 3:16 (ESV): "Moreover, I saw under the sun that in the place of justice, even there was wickedness,"

questions.question: A time to tear, and a time to what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 3:7 (ESV): "a time to tear, and a time to sew;"

questions.question: A time to love, and a time to what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 3:8 (ESV): "a time to love, and a time to hate;"

questions.question: God seeks what has been what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 3:15 (ESV): "and God seeks what has been driven away."

questions.question: Who knows whether the spirit of man goes upward and the spirit of the beast goes where?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 3:21 (ESV): "Who knows whether the spirit of man goes upward and the spirit of the beast goes down into the earth?"

questions.question: So I saw that there is nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 3:22 (ESV): "So I saw that there is nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his work, for that is his lot."

key_verse_text: For everything there is a season, and a time for every matter under heaven:
